Usage: drive metrics [flags]

Print the batch's measures: asks and the owner's wait, merges, sends, wakes, refusals.

Flags:
      --json           Print one JSON document instead of text.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME     Act in this batch, as drive prints its name, instead of the driver's current
                       one. It may stand anywhere on the line.
      --driver=NAME    Act in the batch this driver drives now; a chat driver's name is its
                       webhook's. It may stand anywhere on the line.

JSON:
  batch, from, to, sessions; asks, answered, unanswered, took (counts of recommended,
  amended, delegated, moot), explained; owner_wait_seconds, median_answer_seconds,
  per_merge_seconds; merged (repo, number or branch and commit, at, sessions), unread;
  sends, snippets, by_key, commands, own_words, recovered, garbled, other, unknown;
  refusals (counts by kind), failures; wakes, timers, wake_fails, unhandled, unwatched

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner
